Summary: Unitarity implies nonnegativity of all imaginary parts and the explicit diagonal contribution gives \(\mathrm{Im}\,a_{\ell}^{iiii}\ge \tfrac12|a_{\ell}^{iiii}|^{2}\). All imaginary parts are bounded above by 1 (elastic-channel maximal value), and off-diagonal imaginary parts satisfy Cauchy–Schwarz bounds in terms of diagonal imaginary parts.
